budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town will owe a abatement payment of $48,000 plus about $18,000 interest, to be confirmed by the Board of Assessors; the Town hopes to pay soon because interest compounds daily.
budget_items.quote: the town will owe $48,000 dollars plus about $18,000 interest.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town anticipates saving $200-225,000 per year once the solar credits begin; the credit rate (17.1 or 18.1 cents) is still being discussed with Unitil.
budget_items.quote: town is anticipating saving $200-225,000 per year when the credits begin.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town has received part of FEMA reimbursement and has a remaining shortfall; the state DoR requires the Town to fund the deficit, and borrowing may be needed.
budget_items.quote: we have received 400,000 and have $157,000 to go.
